MediaPipeFilter

class MediaPipeFilter[source]

Bases: object

Enhance camera frames and smooth pose landmarks.

All thresholds and factors are read from CalibrationService when the object is created, except the brightness limits and the movement threshold, which are read on every call.

Attributes:
serviceCalibrationService

Source of the filter settings.

clahecv2.CLAHE

CLAHE operator built with the configured clip limit and tile grid size.

smoothing_framesint

Number of recent positions averaged per landmark.

historydict[int, collections.deque]

Recent (x, y) positions per landmark index, each deque limited to smoothing_frames items.

gamma_tablenumpy.ndarray

256-entry uint8 lookup table for gamma correction.

Notes

The gamma table maps each level i to 255 * (i / 255) ** (1 / gamma), where gamma is get_filter_gamma_factor().

apply_enhancements(frame)[source]

Apply the filters that suit the frame brightness.

Parameters:
framenumpy.ndarray

BGR image from OpenCV.

Returns:
numpy.ndarray

The enhanced BGR image (or the input frame if no filter applies).

Notes

Brightness is the mean of the V channel in HSV (0-255). Below get_filter_clahe_lum_below() CLAHE is applied to help the detection in dark scenes; above get_filter_gamma_lum_above() gamma correction is applied for full-light scenes. Both checks use the brightness of the original frame.

smooth_landmarks(pose_landmarks_list)[source]

Smooth landmark positions with a moving average.

Parameters:
pose_landmarks_listlist

One list of normalized landmarks per detected pose, as in PoseLandmarkerResult.pose_landmarks.

Returns:
list

The same list, with x and y of each landmark replaced in place by the average of its last smoothing_frames positions; an empty list when the input is empty.

Notes

All body landmarks are smoothed. When a landmark moves farther than get_filter_landmark_limit() (Euclidean distance in normalized x, y) from its last position, its history is cleared so fast movements, such as steps, are not delayed. An empty input clears the whole history.

The history is keyed only by landmark index, so with more than one detected pose the positions of different people are averaged together.
